LanguageData.MiliraXian_BackStoryChild_Qinghe_BS1.des: [PAWN_nameDef] looks a little like Qiluo, but there is no doubt that she is a pure Milira.\nAmong the six branches evolved from "Ji", she presides over life and balance.\n"So I chose to keep company with flowing water and music."
LanguageData.MiliraXian_BackStoryAdult_Qinghe_BS1.des: [PAWN_nameDef] governs the power of balance. Rather than resorting to violence, she prefers to support her friends with water and music, but if necessary she will take up arms without hesitation.\n"I'm sorry, if this is the ending you wanted."
